question: Under whose captainship did India defeat England by four wickets to clinch a record-extending fifth U19 Men’s Cricket World Cup title at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, Antigua, in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yash Dhull.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Under captainship did India defeat England by four wickets to clinch a record-extending fifth U19 Men’s Cricket World Cup title at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, Antigua, in 2022.**
 
• **Yash Dhull became the fifth Indian captain to win the world cup title after Mohammad Kaif, Virat Kohli, Unmukt Chand, and Prithvi Shaw.**
 
• India defeated England by four wickets and won the** fifth world cup title at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, Antigua.**
 
• **India had previously won the trophy in 2000, 2008, 2012, and 2018.**
 
• **Raj Angad Bawa takes 5/31 in U19 World Cup final **and He won the **Man of the Match Title.**
 
• India win the **2022 U19 World Cup title**, by beating England by 4 wickets Shaik Rasheed and Nishant Sindhu cracked the 50s in a chase of **190 as India clinched a record-extending fifth U19 World Cup title in Antigua.**
 
• **Raj Bawa **claimed a fifer while Ravi Kumar bagged 4 wickets to fold England to 189.
 
• **BCCI president Sourav Ganguly announced a cash prize of 40 lakhs.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• ICC Under 19 World Cup:

 
 
• The ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup is an international cricket tournament organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• It is contested by national under-19 teams.
 
• The first edition was held in 1988, as the Youth World Cup.
 
• It was not staged again until 1998. Since then, the World Cup has been held as a biennial event.
 
• India has won the World Cup a record five times and India is the most successful team.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Cricket Council:

 
 
• Predecessor: Imperial Cricket Conference (1909 - 1965), International Cricket Conference (1965 - 1989)
 
• Formation: 15 June 1909
 
• Headquarters: Dubai.
 
• Members: 106*
 
• Chairman: Greg Barclay(New Zealand)
 
• Deputy Chairman: Imran Khwaja (Singapore).
